$Comment: What a participant sees when a boss fight is lost: every member dead or gone for the fight's
WipeGraceSeconds, or the fight torn down mid-run.
This is the library's own neutral default; a mod's same-named file or the owner layer
replaces it, and the binding row's Feedback.Wiped leaf can point a fight elsewhere.
The moment fires once per participant and carries 'encounter' (the script id), 'title' (the
fight's name in the reader's language), 'members', 'seconds' (how long the fight lasted),
'share' (this reader's share, whole percent points) and 'rank', plus 'participants' and
'source'. 'player' is the participant it is about.
A plain Info notice: a wipe is news, not a payout, and it is deliberately quiet, since the
screen already went grey. Add a Sound for a sting, or a Broadcast to tell the arena.
